scope: lucide-static 1.41.0 to 1.69.0 (icon source of src/icons.ts and of the triangle-alert CSS mask in src/styles.css); whether the copied icon geometries and the retained license text change. Not final application compliance or installer delivery.

icons.method: scripts/gen-icons.mjs reads icons/<name>.svg for the 19 names it lists and strips the XML comment; compared with the comment removed. In both versions each file differs only in its first line, the comment '@license lucide-static v<version> - ISC'.

decision: The decision for npm:lucide-static stands for 1.69.0: the same ISC license text (with the Feather MIT text) and byte-identical geometries in src/icons.ts and in the triangle-alert mask of src/styles.css. THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md names the new version.
